judgments.reason: The MRI finding 'a mass arising from the right frontal diploic space' directly identifies the frontal bone as the site of involvement, supporting the anatomical modifier specifying metastasis to the frontal bone.

The CT finding 'a lytic lesion of the right frontal bone' explicitly names the right frontal bone as the location of the lytic lesion, directly supporting the anatomical modifier of metastasis to the frontal bone.
